articles.title: Can a Fruit Fly Brain Mine Bitcoin? These Companies Are Testing It
articles.snippet: The HashFly browser experiment uses a digital neural model for Bitcoin hashing and projects greater efficiency from a hypothetical biological version.

articles.title: Are we back? Crypto is Green! Solana Intern goes rogue! Pump up 13%! Monero hits another ATH!
articles.snippet: BTC: 95k (+3%) | BTC.D: 59.2% (-0.1%). ETH: 3313 (+6%) | BNB: 936 (+3%) | SOL: 145 (+2%). Top Gainers: IP, ICP, PUMP, PEPE, ENA. BTC ETFs: +$754m | ETH ETFs: +$130m.
